CRedo in Christum passum, id est credo. 1. Quod Chri-

l.i: stus inde a conceptionis momento omnis generis calami-

ad compensationem & meorum & aliorum peccatorum, atq;
ad placationem irae adversus genus humanum.

main_text.l: Differunt, Christum esse passum credere, & in Christum
passum credere. Illud enim est tantum fidem historicam
habere de Christi passione, nec in eo fiduciam ponere:
hoc vero est credere:non tantum quod Christus
sit passus, sed etiam suam fiduciam in eius passione
collocare.

page.notes: Running head and page number read from a small, worn print; "401" is uncertain (the last digit is old-style and hard to make out). The opening word "mùm" is a fragment and is uncertain. The colon in "credere:non" is printed without a space and may be a spacing fault. The woodcut initial P is joined to "PASSIO". Italic runs were judged from the scan; the first words of "Credo" are roman.
